name: Tenkuu Danzai Skelter Heaven
original_name: 天空断罪 スケルターヘブン
source:
Wet Prope is a military project to create artificially-enhanced super-soldiers, capable of piloting large, powerful mechs known as Skelters. The project has seen both success and failure -- early attempts to create male soldiers failed, while later attempts to create female subjects showed far more promise -- but in recent years, almost half a dozen successful subjects have been produced. In the year 2030, 15 years after the project was initiated, it has become time to prove its worth; hostile squid-like alien creatures have begun appearing, and there's nobody else capable of fighting them.

Tenkuu Danzai Skelter Heaven is a sci-fi visual novel with very light rhythm game elements. The player takes the role of Otsuya, part of the Wet Prope project and the direct commander of the pilots. The game mostly proceeds as semi-voiced text and graphics, with occasional dialogue choices influencing the story and Otsuya's relationship with the pilots. Battle scenes play out from a first-person view from the cockpit; targets approach the center of the screen from different directions, and the player must press the correct buttons at the right time to "assist" the pilot. Performance in these sections also affects the outcome of the story.

[Edited from [url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/ps2/tenk-danzai-skelterheaven]MobyGames[/url]]
translation:
Wet Prope是一个军事项目，旨在创造人工增强的超级士兵，能够驾驶被称为“Skelters”的大型强大机甲。该项目既有成功也有失败——早期创造男性士兵的尝试失败了，而后来创造女性受试者的尝试显示出了更大的希望——但近年来，已经生产了近六名成功的受试者。2030年，项目启动15年后，到了证明其价值的时候了；充满敌意的类似鱿鱼的外星生物已经开始出现，而且没有其他人有能力对抗它们。

《天空段子Skelter Heaven》是一款科幻视觉小说，带有非常轻快的节奏游戏元素。玩家扮演大津谷的角色，他是湿地项目的一部分，也是飞行员的直接指挥官。游戏主要以半语音文本和图形的形式进行，偶尔的对话选择会影响故事以及大津谷与飞行员的关系。战斗场景从驾驶舱以第一人称视角呈现；目标从不同方向接近屏幕中心，玩家必须在正确的时间按下正确的按钮来“协助”飞行员。这些部分的表现也会影响故事的结果。

[编辑自[url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/ps2/tenk-danzai-skelterheaven]MobyGames[/url]]
